cli.name: inspect

cli.description: Count characters or show frequency table
cli.name: count

cli.description: Test a regex pattern against text
cli.name: regex

cli.description: Extract a line range from text
cli.name: lines

cli.description: Split a shell command into argv tokens
cli.name: shell-split

argv_compare.description: Compare two command strings or argv lists by parsed argv tokens rather than raw text. Supports command strings, pre-parsed argv lists, or both.

left_command.description: Left command string to parse and compare

right_command.description: Right command string to parse and compare

argv_equal.description: True if parsed argv lists are identical

first_difference.description: Index of first differing token, or null if equal

canonicalize_text.description: Apply a named text canonicalization profile. Profiles include source_file_identity (NFC + LF + newline), identifier_compare (NFC + casefold), human_label_compare (NFC + casefold + whitespace collapse), json_key_compare (NFC + casefold), and path_segment_compare (NFC + lowercase + LF).

return_mapping.description: If True, include a character mapping of changes

mapping.description: Character mapping if return_mapping was True

cargo_toml_inspect.description: Inspect Cargo.toml text without network or filesystem access. Reports package metadata, workspace configuration, dependency forms (version/path/git/workspace), path dependencies, suspicious or confusable dependency names, and structural findings.

duplicate_or_confusable_dependency_names.description: Dependency names that normalize to the same form

findings.description: Structured findings with code, severity, message, line, column

code_fence_extract.description: Extract fenced code blocks from Markdown with exact line ranges, optional language filter, content, and SHA-256 fingerprints. Reports unclosed fences.

blocks.description: Extracted code blocks with index, language, lines, content, fingerprint

command_preflight.description: Composite: analyze a command before user approval or execution. Calls shell_split and regex_safety_check. Returns parsed argv, shell operators, risk findings, and a verdict. Must not execute anything.

config_preflight.description: Composite: validate generated config text. Auto-detects format and runs the appropriate validator. Returns valid/invalid, detected format, parse error location, and machine code.

constant_lookup.description: Look up physical constant values and symbols (Avogadro, Planck, speed of light, etc.).

diff_file_headers.description: Extract metadata from diff file headers: diff --git line, index hash, mode changes, rename/copy directives, and binary indicators.

max_files.description: Maximum number of files to process

patch_text.description: The unified diff text to analyze

hunks_count.description: Number of hunks in this file

is_new_file.description: True if file is newly added

diff_hunk_ranges.description: Extract hunk ranges per file with line count classification (added/deleted/context) from a unified diff.

max_files.description: Maximum number of files to process

patch_text.description: The unified diff text to analyze

diff_touched_paths.description: Classify files in a unified diff as added, deleted, renamed, or modified. Also detects binary diffs and file mode changes.

max_files.description: Maximum number of files to process

patch_text.description: The unified diff text to analyze

dotenv_validate.description: Validate .env-style key=value configuration text. Detects invalid keys, duplicate keys, missing quotes, and variable expansion syntax. Line-by-line parser, no shell evaluation.

duplicates.description: Duplicate key entries with line numbers

entries.description: Parsed entries with key, value, quote_style, line

parse_ok.description: True if no parse errors found

requires_quoting.description: Keys whose values contain spaces and should be quoted

edit_preflight.description: Composite: validate a proposed edit before applying it. Calls text_replace_check, patch_apply_check, line_range_extract, text_fingerprint, and text_diff_explain as needed. Returns ok_to_apply verdict with findings and machine codes.

replacement_mode.description: Edit mode: literal (old/new), patch (unified diff), or line_range

escape_text.description: Escape text for various output formats.

glob_match.description: Match a glob pattern against a path with explicit semantics: * matches within one segment, ** matches zero or more segments, ? matches one char. Python fnmatch limitations around ** are documented.

go_mod_inspect.description: Inspect go.mod text: module path, go version, toolchain, require count, replace/exclude directives. Deterministic, no network.

identifier_analyze.description: Classify and validate identifier naming conventions across languages.

languages.description: Languages to check (python, rust, javascript, env)

suggestions.description: Map of language to suggested name

identifier_inspect.description: Inspect identifiers for validity and collisions. Detects confusables, mixed scripts, normalization issues, and casefold collisions across a list of identifiers.

identifiers.description: List of identifier strings to inspect
Per-identifier analysis with raw, normalized, valid, scripts, and issues

identifier_table_inspect.description: Inspect a table of identifiers for casefold collisions, normalization collisions, confusable/near-collisions, style variants, reserved keyword hits, and mixed naming style groups. Accepts structured entries with name, kind, file, and line metadata.

checks.description: Subset of checks: casefold, normalization, confusable, style, reserved, mixed_style

identifiers.description: List of identifier entries to inspect

language.description: Target language for reserved keyword checking

ini_validate.description: Validate simple INI-style configuration files. Supports [section] headers, key=value and key:value lines, comments. Detects duplicate sections, duplicate keys, and malformed lines.

parse_ok.description: True if no parse errors found

json_canonicalize.description: Canonicalize JSON with deterministic formatting, key ordering, duplicate key detection, and stable hashes.

detect_duplicate_keys.description: Report duplicate keys in the input

ensure_ascii.description: Use ASCII escaping for non-ASCII characters

trailing_newline.description: Add a trailing newline to the canonical form

json_compare.description: Compare two JSON documents semantically, ignoring formatting and key order.

json_extract.description: Extract a value from JSON using RFC 6901 JSON Pointer (e.g., /foo/bar/0). Navigate nested objects and arrays.

json_query.description: Extract a value from JSON using RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Navigate nested objects and arrays. Deprecated: use json_extract instead, which provides richer output including available_keys, missing_at, and detail levels.

json_shape.description: Analyze the structure of a JSON document without returning values. Shows type, keys, and nested structure with configurable depth limits.

max_keys.description: Maximum keys to show per object

shape.description: Nested shape structure with type, keys, and counts

line_range_compare.description: Compare a line range from two text inputs with exact, trailing-whitespace-ignoring, or newline-normalizing comparison.

equal.description: True if ranges are equal under the chosen mode

line_range_extract.description: Extract exact line ranges from text and return stable offsets, byte positions, line counts, and optional fingerprint.

include_fingerprint.description: Compute SHA-256 fingerprint of extracted text

include_line_numbers.description: Include line number in each line dict

line_base.description: Base for line numbers (1 for 1-based, 0 for 0-based)

valid_range.description: True if range is within bounds

list_compare.description: Compare two lists with explicit modes: ordered ( LCS-based alignment), set (presence only), multiset (count deltas). Near matches are optional and never replace exact missing/extra results.

ignore_order.description: Legacy: use mode=set or mode=multiset instead

mode.description: Comparison mode: ordered (first diff, aligned ops), set (presence only), multiset (count deltas)

near_match_threshold.description: Maximum edit distance for near matches

near_matches.description: Items that differ only by edit distance

list_dedupe.description: Remove duplicates from a list while preserving order. Supports Unicode normalization and casefolding.

stable.description: Accepted for compatibility; deduplication keeps first occurrence order

list_sort.description: Sort a list of strings with Unicode normalization and casefold support.

stable.description: Accepted for compatibility; Python sorting is always stable

llm_json_output_check.description: Detect and diagnose common LLM JSON output issues: fenced code blocks, leading/trailing prose, parse errors with location, fix hints for trailing commas/single quotes/unquoted keys, and multiple concatenated objects.

text.description: LLM output text to analyze for JSON issues

error_col.description: Column number of first parse error

error_line.description: Line number of first parse error

extracted_content.description: Cleaned JSON content if fence/prose was detected

has_fence.description: True if JSON is wrapped in markdown code fence

leading_prose.description: True if non-JSON content precedes the JSON

multiple_json_objects.description: True if multiple JSON objects concatenated

trailing_prose.description: True if non-JSON content follows the JSON

lockfile_summary.description: Shallow lockfile summary: detect kind (npm/pnpm/yarn/poetry/uv/cargo/go), approximate package count, ecosystem. Intentionally shallow, no full parse.

markdown_link_check_lexical.description: Lexical markdown link validation (no network). Detects malformed links, duplicate anchors, unresolved relative links, and counts external/image links.

known_paths.description: Optional list of known file paths for resolving relative links

malformed.description: Malformed links with line and reason

markdown_structure.description: Parse Markdown structure with a deterministic line scanner: headings (level, text, slug), code fences (language, open/close state), links (visible vs target mismatch), HTML comments, frontmatter detection, and table detection. Not a full CommonMark parser.

code_fences.description: Code fences with language, lines, closed state

headings.description: Headings with level, text, line, slug

html_comments.description: HTML comments with text and position

links.description: Links with visible text, target, mismatch flags

math_eval.description: Evaluate arithmetic, unit conversions, constants, and scientific expressions deterministically. State-mutating functions (setvar, store, etc.) and non-deterministic functions (random, randint, gauss, etc.) are disabled. Use for math and unit tasks instead of asking the model to calculate.

expression.description: Math expression to evaluate (e.g., '5 + 3', '30m + 100ft', 'five plus three')

display.description: Human-readable result with units (only when result has units)

type.description: Python type name of the result

unit.description: Unit name (only when result has units)

package_json_inspect.description: Inspect package.json text: name, version, scripts, dependency counts, engines, packageManager, workspaces. Deterministic, no network.

patch_apply_check.description: Validate and simulate a unified diff against provided in-memory files/text without touching the filesystem. Reports parse status, application success, failed hunks with context, and optional result fingerprint.

original_text.description: The original source text to apply the patch to

return_result_fingerprint.description: If True, compute SHA-256 fingerprint of the result

return_result_text.description: If True, include the resulting text (bounded to 50000 chars)

strict.description: If True, context lines must match exactly

affected_line_ranges.description: Line ranges affected by successful hunks

applies.description: True if all hunks applied cleanly

hunks_applied.description: Number of hunks that applied successfully

hunks_failed.description: Number of hunks that failed to apply

hunks_total.description: Total number of hunks in patch

patch_conflict_markers_inspect.description: Detect and analyze conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>) in text. Reports counts, balance, nesting, and line locations.

text.description: Text to scan for conflict markers

imbalanced.description: True if start and end markers are unbalanced

locations.description: Line numbers and types of each marker

nested.description: True if conflict markers are nested

total_markers.description: Total number of conflict markers found

patch_summary.description: Summarize a unified diff without applying it. Reports file counts, hunk counts, additions, deletions, renames, and line ranges by file.

patch_text.description: The unified diff text to summarize

binary_patch_detected.description: True if binary patch content detected

hunks_total.description: Total number of hunks across all files

path_analyze.description: Analyze path components, extensions, hidden status, and traversal without filesystem access.

path_compare.description: Compare two paths under explicit normalization rules: separator normalization, dot-segment collapsing, and optional case-insensitive comparison.

equal.description: Whether paths are equal under normalization

path_normalize.description: Normalize a path using posixpath or ntpath semantics. Collapse dot segments, resolve components.

path_scope_check.description: Determine whether a target path remains lexically inside a declared root. Lexical only, does not resolve symlinks.

inside_root.description: Whether target is lexically inside root

relative_path.description: Relative path from root to target (if inside)

prompt_input_inspect.description: Deterministically inspect text for red flags that may influence agents or humans unexpectedly. Detects hidden Unicode characters, bidirectional controls, HTML comments, Markdown link mismatches, ANSI escapes, terminal controls, base64-like blobs, instruction-like phrases, and very long minified lines. This is NOT a prompt-injection detector -- it reports observable features only, not intent.

checks.description: Subset of checks to run: unicode_hidden, bidi, html_comments, markdown_links, ansi_escapes, terminal_controls, base64_like_blobs, instruction_phrases, long_minified_lines

phrase_patterns.description: Optional literal strings or safe regexes to detect as instruction-like phrases. Pass null for no custom patterns.

text.description: The text to inspect for red flags

findings.description: Structured findings with code, severity, message, span, and details

findings_truncated.description: True if findings were truncated due to limits

pyproject_inspect.description: Inspect pyproject.toml text: project name/version, build backend, dependencies, optional groups, scripts, tool sections, package-manager signals. Deterministic, no network.

regex_finditer.description: Find all regex matches in text with positions, line/column info, and capture groups.

matches.description: List of regex matches with positions and groups

regex_safety_check.description: Heuristic check for potential catastrophic backtracking risks in regex patterns. Flags nested quantifiers, repeated alternations, ambiguous dot-star, and backreferences.

findings.description: Safety findings with kind, span, and message

repo_file_inventory.description: Analyze file inventory for repo structure signals (no filesystem access). Detects language/ecosystem signals, counts files by category, identifies config/vendor/generated files, and finds suspicious paths.

hashes.description: Optional mapping of path to content hash for duplicate detection

paths.description: List of file paths to analyze

sizes.description: Optional mapping of path to file size in bytes

by_category.description: File count by category (source, test, config, doc, data, hidden, other)

duplicate_hashes.description: Groups of files with identical content hashes

generated_candidates.description: Paths that appear to be generated files

total_size.description: Total size in bytes (if sizes provided)

truncation_warning.description: True if input was truncated due to size limits

requirements_inspect.description: Inspect requirements.txt-style text: package specs, editable refs, direct URLs, VCS refs, comments, environment markers, suspicious lines. Deterministic, no network.

shell_quote_join.description: Safely quote a list of argv tokens into a POSIX-like shell string. Verifies round-trip safety with shell_split.

argv.description: List of argument strings to join

roundtrip_ok.description: True if shell_split(quote_join(argv)) produces equivalent argv

shell_split.description: Parse a shell-like command string into argv tokens and report risky lexical features (pipes, redirections, command substitution, variable expansion, globs, control operators). Lexical POSIX-like parsing only, not full shell evaluation.

command.description: The shell command string to parse

detect_risky_features.description: Whether to detect risky lexical features

parse_ok.description: True if the command parsed successfully

structured_data_compare.description: Composite: compare structured config/data output. Calls json_compare, json_canonicalize, and json_shape. Returns equal/not-equal verdict with structured diffs.

text_count.description: Count exact characters or produce a character frequency table with codepoint positions, grapheme clusters, bytes, or substring matches.

count_mode.description: Count mode: codepoint (Python str), grapheme (user-perceived), byte (UTF-8), substring

target.description: Single character to count (None for frequency table)

outputSchema.description: With target: {count, positions, target, normalization, text_length_codepoints}. Without target: character frequency table as {char: count} pairs.

text_diff_explain.description: Explain why two strings differ, including spans, codepoints, Unicode names, normalization equivalence, confusables, invisibles, and agent-facing classification.

detail.description: Detail level: summary (compact), normal, or full

text_equal.description: Compare two strings under raw, Unicode-normalized, casefolded, or trimmed modes and report exact equality evidence.

ignore_final_newline.description: Ignore trailing newline at end of strings

ignore_newline_style.description: Normalize different newline styles before comparison

ignore_trailing_whitespace.description: Ignore trailing whitespace on each line

text_fingerprint.description: Compute a deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint of text with canonicalization options for Unicode normalization, newline style, casefold, and final newline trimming.

text_hash.description: Compute cryptographic hashes of text for identity checking.

hashes.description: Map of algorithm to hash value

text_inspect.description: Inspect a string for hidden characters, Unicode confusables, mixed scripts, normalization state, and display-safe representation. Can report both original and normalized text analysis.

compare_normalized.description: Report both original and normalized analysis

detail.description: Detail level: summary (compact), normal, or full

text_measure.description: Measure exact text properties: UTF-8 byte length, codepoint count, words, lines, whitespace, newline style, Unicode normalization state, invisibles, and mixed-script signals.

text_position.description: Convert between byte offsets, codepoint indices, line/column positions, and UTF-16 offsets.

text_replace_check.description: Check whether a text replacement would apply cleanly before an agent attempts to edit. Reports match count, positions, ambiguity, and optional preview of before/after.

allow_multiple.description: If False and more than one match, add a finding

return_preview.description: If True, include before/after text previews

expected_count_met.description: True if match count matches expected_count

positions.description: Match positions with byte offsets and line/column

would_change.description: True if replacement would change text

text_security_inspect.description: Composite security-oriented text hygiene pass. Runs text_inspect, unicode_policy_check, canonicalize_text, prompt_input_inspect, and identifier_inspect depending on policy. Returns a verdict (allow/review/block) plus structured findings and machine codes.

compare_normalized.description: Report both original and normalized analysis

detail.description: Detail level: summary (compact verdict only), normal, or full (includes subresults)

text_transform.description: Apply deterministic text transformations: Unicode normalization (NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD), casefold, trim, newline normalization, zero-width removal, bidi control stripping, and visible representation.

operations.description: Operations to apply: normalize_nfc, normalize_nfd, normalize_nfkc, normalize_nfkd, casefold, trim, trim_trailing_whitespace, normalize_newlines_lf, ensure_final_newline, strip_final_newline, remove_zero_width, remove_bidi_controls, visible_repr

text_truncate.description: Truncate a string to a specified number of grapheme clusters (user-perceived characters). Preserves emoji, combining sequences, and flag sequences intact. Useful for AI agent prompts where visual length matters.

max_graphemes.description: Maximum number of grapheme clusters to return

text_window.description: Get a window around a position in text with context lines. Shows line at position with surrounding context, position metrics, and character details.

context_lines.description: Number of context lines before and after

include_visible_repr.description: Include visible representation of the line

position.description: Position specification with kind and value

value.description: Value for byte_offset, codepoint_index, or grapheme_index

position.description: Resolved position with byte_offset, codepoint_index, grapheme_index, line, column

toml_shape.description: Analyze the structure of a TOML document: top-level keys, tables, and nesting hierarchy.

unicode_policy_check.description: Apply a named deterministic Unicode safety policy to input text. Policies include identifier_strict (mixed scripts, bidi, confusables), filename_safe (control chars, path separators, reserved names), source_code, human_text (warn-only), json_key, and domain_like.

findings.description: Policy findings with rule, severity, and message

pass_.description: True if text passes the policy (no errors)

unified_diff_validate.description: Validate the structural integrity of a unified diff. Checks parse success, hunk header format, line count consistency, and stray lines.

check_line_counts.description: If True, validate hunk header line counts

patch_text.description: The unified diff text to validate

files_count.description: Number of files in the diff

structure_valid.description: True if the diff structure is valid

unit_convert.description: Convert a numeric value from one unit to another using pre-defined conversion factors.

value.description: Numeric value to convert (must be finite; NaN and infinity are rejected)

factor.description: Conversion factor used (null for temperature conversions)

unit_info.description: Get information about a unit including its canonical form and category.

validate_brackets.description: Check whether delimiters are structurally balanced and report unmatched delimiters with line/column positions.

validate_json.description: Validate JSON and report precise parse errors or top-level structure information.

text.description: Input string to validate as JSON

validate_regex.description: Test a Python regular expression against sample strings and report match/fullmatch status, spans, groups, and errors.

samples.description: List of strings to test against

validate_schema_light.description: Validate JSON against a simple schema format with type, required, enum, pattern, and nested constraints.

violations.description: Schema violations with path and message

validate_toml.description: Validate TOML configuration files (Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, etc.) and report parse errors with line/column positions.

version_compare.description: Compare two version strings with explicit scheme. Supports semver (major.minor.patch, pre-release identifiers ignored in comparison) and loose (numeric parts only). PEP 440 is not supported.

scheme.description: Version scheme ('semver' for major.minor.patch with pre-release/build metadata, 'loose' for numeric-part-only comparison)

valid.description: Whether versions are valid for the scheme

version_constraint_check.description: Check whether a version satisfies a constraint under a declared versioning scheme. Supports semver exact/comparison/range constraints and cargo caret, tilde, and wildcard constraints.

scheme.description: Versioning scheme to use for parsing and evaluation

satisfies.description: Whether the version satisfies the constraint

has_fence.description: True if JSON is wrapped in markdown code fence

leading_prose.description: True if non-JSON content precedes the JSON

multiple_json_objects.description: True if multiple JSON objects concatenated

trailing_prose.description: True if non-JSON content follows the JSON

lockfile_summary.description: Shallow lockfile summary: detect kind (npm/pnpm/yarn/poetry/uv/cargo/go), approximate package count, ecosystem. Intentionally shallow, no full parse.

markdown_link_check_lexical.description: Lexical markdown link validation (no network). Detects malformed links, duplicate anchors, unresolved relative links, and counts external/image links.

known_paths.description: Optional list of known file paths for resolving relative links

malformed.description: Malformed links with line and reason

markdown_structure.description: Parse Markdown structure with a deterministic line scanner: headings (level, text, slug), code fences (language, open/close state), links (visible vs target mismatch), HTML comments, frontmatter detection, and table detection. Not a full CommonMark parser.

code_fences.description: Code fences with language, lines, closed state

headings.description: Headings with level, text, line, slug

html_comments.description: HTML comments with text and position

links.description: Links with visible text, target, mismatch flags

math_eval.description: Evaluate arithmetic, unit conversions, constants, and scientific expressions deterministically. State-mutating functions (setvar, store, etc.) and non-deterministic functions (random, randint, gauss, etc.) are disabled. Use for math and unit tasks instead of asking the model to calculate.

expression.description: Math expression to evaluate (e.g., '5 + 3', '30m + 100ft', 'five plus three')

display.description: Human-readable result with units (only when result has units)

type.description: Python type name of the result

unit.description: Unit name (only when result has units)

package_json_inspect.description: Inspect package.json text: name, version, scripts, dependency counts, engines, packageManager, workspaces. Deterministic, no network.

patch_apply_check.description: Validate and simulate a unified diff against provided in-memory files/text without touching the filesystem. Reports parse status, application success, failed hunks with context, and optional result fingerprint.

original_text.description: The original source text to apply the patch to

return_result_fingerprint.description: If True, compute SHA-256 fingerprint of the result

return_result_text.description: If True, include the resulting text (bounded to 50000 chars)

strict.description: If True, context lines must match exactly

affected_line_ranges.description: Line ranges affected by successful hunks

applies.description: True if all hunks applied cleanly

hunks_applied.description: Number of hunks that applied successfully

hunks_failed.description: Number of hunks that failed to apply

hunks_total.description: Total number of hunks in patch

patch_conflict_markers_inspect.description: Detect and analyze conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>) in text. Reports counts, balance, nesting, and line locations.

text.description: Text to scan for conflict markers

imbalanced.description: True if start and end markers are unbalanced

locations.description: Line numbers and types of each marker

nested.description: True if conflict markers are nested

total_markers.description: Total number of conflict markers found

patch_summary.description: Summarize a unified diff without applying it. Reports file counts, hunk counts, additions, deletions, renames, and line ranges by file.

patch_text.description: The unified diff text to summarize

binary_patch_detected.description: True if binary patch content detected

hunks_total.description: Total number of hunks across all files

path_analyze.description: Analyze path components, extensions, hidden status, and traversal without filesystem access.

path_compare.description: Compare two paths under explicit normalization rules: separator normalization, dot-segment collapsing, and optional case-insensitive comparison.

equal.description: Whether paths are equal under normalization

path_normalize.description: Normalize a path using posixpath or ntpath semantics. Collapse dot segments, resolve components.

path_scope_check.description: Determine whether a target path remains lexically inside a declared root. Lexical only, does not resolve symlinks.

inside_root.description: Whether target is lexically inside root

relative_path.description: Relative path from root to target (if inside)

prompt_input_inspect.description: Deterministically inspect text for red flags that may influence agents or humans unexpectedly. Detects hidden Unicode characters, bidirectional controls, HTML comments, Markdown link mismatches, ANSI escapes, terminal controls, base64-like blobs, instruction-like phrases, and very long minified lines. This is NOT a prompt-injection detector -- it reports observable features only, not intent.

checks.description: Subset of checks to run: unicode_hidden, bidi, html_comments, markdown_links, ansi_escapes, terminal_controls, base64_like_blobs, instruction_phrases, long_minified_lines

phrase_patterns.description: Optional literal strings or safe regexes to detect as instruction-like phrases. Pass null for no custom patterns.

text.description: The text to inspect for red flags

findings.description: Structured findings with code, severity, message, span, and details

findings_truncated.description: True if findings were truncated due to limits

pyproject_inspect.description: Inspect pyproject.toml text: project name/version, build backend, dependencies, optional groups, scripts, tool sections, package-manager signals. Deterministic, no network.

regex_finditer.description: Find all regex matches in text with positions, line/column info, and capture groups.

matches.description: List of regex matches with positions and groups

regex_safety_check.description: Heuristic check for potential catastrophic backtracking risks in regex patterns. Flags nested quantifiers, repeated alternations, ambiguous dot-star, and backreferences.

findings.description: Safety findings with kind, span, and message

repo_file_inventory.description: Analyze file inventory for repo structure signals (no filesystem access). Detects language/ecosystem signals, counts files by category, identifies config/vendor/generated files, and finds suspicious paths.

hashes.description: Optional mapping of path to content hash for duplicate detection

paths.description: List of file paths to analyze

sizes.description: Optional mapping of path to file size in bytes

by_category.description: File count by category (source, test, config, doc, data, hidden, other)

duplicate_hashes.description: Groups of files with identical content hashes

generated_candidates.description: Paths that appear to be generated files

total_size.description: Total size in bytes (if sizes provided)

truncation_warning.description: True if input was truncated due to size limits

requirements_inspect.description: Inspect requirements.txt-style text: package specs, editable refs, direct URLs, VCS refs, comments, environment markers, suspicious lines. Deterministic, no network.

shell_quote_join.description: Safely quote a list of argv tokens into a POSIX-like shell string. Verifies round-trip safety with shell_split.

argv.description: List of argument strings to join

roundtrip_ok.description: True if shell_split(quote_join(argv)) produces equivalent argv

shell_split.description: Parse a shell-like command string into argv tokens and report risky lexical features (pipes, redirections, command substitution, variable expansion, globs, control operators). Lexical POSIX-like parsing only, not full shell evaluation.

command.description: The shell command string to parse

detect_risky_features.description: Whether to detect risky lexical features

parse_ok.description: True if the command parsed successfully

structured_data_compare.description: Composite: compare structured config/data output. Calls json_compare, json_canonicalize, and json_shape. Returns equal/not-equal verdict with structured diffs.

text_count.description: Count exact characters or produce a character frequency table with codepoint positions, grapheme clusters, bytes, or substring matches.

count_mode.description: Count mode: codepoint (Python str), grapheme (user-perceived), byte (UTF-8), substring

target.description: Single character to count (None for frequency table)

outputSchema.description: With target: {count, positions, target, normalization, text_length_codepoints}. Without target: character frequency table as {char: count} pairs.

text_diff_explain.description: Explain why two strings differ, including spans, codepoints, Unicode names, normalization equivalence, confusables, invisibles, and agent-facing classification.

detail.description: Detail level: summary (compact), normal, or full

text_equal.description: Compare two strings under raw, Unicode-normalized, casefolded, or trimmed modes and report exact equality evidence.

ignore_final_newline.description: Ignore trailing newline at end of strings

ignore_newline_style.description: Normalize different newline styles before comparison

ignore_trailing_whitespace.description: Ignore trailing whitespace on each line

text_fingerprint.description: Compute a deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint of text with canonicalization options for Unicode normalization, newline style, casefold, and final newline trimming.

text_hash.description: Compute cryptographic hashes of text for identity checking.

hashes.description: Map of algorithm to hash value

text_inspect.description: Inspect a string for hidden characters, Unicode confusables, mixed scripts, normalization state, and display-safe representation. Can report both original and normalized text analysis.

compare_normalized.description: Report both original and normalized analysis

detail.description: Detail level: summary (compact), normal, or full

text_measure.description: Measure exact text properties: UTF-8 byte length, codepoint count, words, lines, whitespace, newline style, Unicode normalization state, invisibles, and mixed-script signals.

text_position.description: Convert between byte offsets, codepoint indices, line/column positions, and UTF-16 offsets.

text_replace_check.description: Check whether a text replacement would apply cleanly before an agent attempts to edit. Reports match count, positions, ambiguity, and optional preview of before/after.

allow_multiple.description: If False and more than one match, add a finding

return_preview.description: If True, include before/after text previews

expected_count_met.description: True if match count matches expected_count

positions.description: Match positions with byte offsets and line/column

would_change.description: True if replacement would change text

text_security_inspect.description: Composite security-oriented text hygiene pass. Runs text_inspect, unicode_policy_check, canonicalize_text, prompt_input_inspect, and identifier_inspect depending on policy. Returns a verdict (allow/review/block) plus structured findings and machine codes.

compare_normalized.description: Report both original and normalized analysis

detail.description: Detail level: summary (compact verdict only), normal, or full (includes subresults)

text_transform.description: Apply deterministic text transformations: Unicode normalization (NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD), casefold, trim, newline normalization, zero-width removal, bidi control stripping, and visible representation.

operations.description: Operations to apply: normalize_nfc, normalize_nfd, normalize_nfkc, normalize_nfkd, casefold, trim, trim_trailing_whitespace, normalize_newlines_lf, ensure_final_newline, strip_final_newline, remove_zero_width, remove_bidi_controls, visible_repr

text_truncate.description: Truncate a string to a specified number of grapheme clusters (user-perceived characters). Preserves emoji, combining sequences, and flag sequences intact. Useful for AI agent prompts where visual length matters.

max_graphemes.description: Maximum number of grapheme clusters to return

text_window.description: Get a window around a position in text with context lines. Shows line at position with surrounding context, position metrics, and character details.

context_lines.description: Number of context lines before and after

include_visible_repr.description: Include visible representation of the line

position.description: Position specification with kind and value

value.description: Value for byte_offset, codepoint_index, or grapheme_index

position.description: Resolved position with byte_offset, codepoint_index, grapheme_index, line, column

toml_shape.description: Analyze the structure of a TOML document: top-level keys, tables, and nesting hierarchy.

unicode_policy_check.description: Apply a named deterministic Unicode safety policy to input text. Policies include identifier_strict (mixed scripts, bidi, confusables), filename_safe (control chars, path separators, reserved names), source_code, human_text (warn-only), json_key, and domain_like.

findings.description: Policy findings with rule, severity, and message

pass_.description: True if text passes the policy (no errors)

unified_diff_validate.description: Validate the structural integrity of a unified diff. Checks parse success, hunk header format, line count consistency, and stray lines.

check_line_counts.description: If True, validate hunk header line counts

patch_text.description: The unified diff text to validate

files_count.description: Number of files in the diff

structure_valid.description: True if the diff structure is valid

unit_convert.description: Convert a numeric value from one unit to another using pre-defined conversion factors.

value.description: Numeric value to convert (must be finite; NaN and infinity are rejected)

factor.description: Conversion factor used (null for temperature conversions)

unit_info.description: Get information about a unit including its canonical form and category.

validate_brackets.description: Check whether delimiters are structurally balanced and report unmatched delimiters with line/column positions.

validate_json.description: Validate JSON and report precise parse errors or top-level structure information.

text.description: Input string to validate as JSON

validate_regex.description: Test a Python regular expression against sample strings and report match/fullmatch status, spans, groups, and errors.

samples.description: List of strings to test against

validate_schema_light.description: Validate JSON against a simple schema format with type, required, enum, pattern, and nested constraints.

violations.description: Schema violations with path and message

validate_toml.description: Validate TOML configuration files (Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, etc.) and report parse errors with line/column positions.

version_compare.description: Compare two version strings with explicit scheme. Supports semver (major.minor.patch, pre-release identifiers ignored in comparison) and loose (numeric parts only). PEP 440 is not supported.

scheme.description: Version scheme ('semver' for major.minor.patch with pre-release/build metadata, 'loose' for numeric-part-only comparison)

valid.description: Whether versions are valid for the scheme

version_constraint_check.description: Check whether a version satisfies a constraint under a declared versioning scheme. Supports semver exact/comparison/range constraints and cargo caret, tilde, and wildcard constraints.

scheme.description: Versioning scheme to use for parsing and evaluation

satisfies.description: Whether the version satisfies the constraint
